site.title: Farmstead mods
site.name: Mods
site.lede: Documentation for the Farmstead Minecraft mods: commands, permissions, configuration and troubleshooting.

products.summary: A fork of ZeroG NeoEssentials: homes, teleports, economy, kits, moderation and permissions — the reference is built from the source.
WorldGuard-style claims: regions from a WorldEdit selection, owners, members and flags. A drop-in replacement for RegionGuard.
Builds from a text prompt: an aiming hologram, block-by-block placement, full undo and spend limits.

products.name: Footprints
products.summary: Realistic footprints for players and every mob in snow, sand and mud: client-side, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge from 1.20.1 to 26.3.

products.name: Fart Together
products.summary: Toots with style: poses, gas clouds, 8 sounds, beans and cabbage, jet jumps and combos with friends. Fabric, Forge and NeoForge from 1.20.1 to 26.3.

products.name: Utilities
products.summary: Small server mods: an animal breeding cap per chunk or region, and a trade chat.
